run_train: run the COPE transformer training loop with default or custom CLI arguments
run_train_with_args: run training with specific data, model, and optimizer arguments via argparse CLI
run_train_distributed: run distributed COPE training across multiple GPUs using the --distributed flag
review_add_train_args: review the add_train_args function that registers all training CLI arguments from data, model, trainer, logger, checkpoint, and distributed modules
review_train_function: review the train function that handles setup, data loading, model building, optimizer creation, and the full epoch training loop with evaluation and checkpointing
